prompt.project_info: A graceful palace-corridor fashion editorial with long peach silk layers, red columns, and patterned sun patches.
prompt.main_subject: An adult East Asian woman with a dark ornate half-up hairstyle, delicate floral hair ornaments, natural warm makeup, and a soft composed smile. She wears a Tang-inspired peach and pale-pink layered hanfu with a chest-high ruqun bodice, airy silk-and-gauze outer layers, wide sleeves, and a gold waist sash; the refined fit complements her feminine silhouette.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical full-length composition in a red-columned palace corridor. The subject lightly gathers one sleeve while standing beside a carved column; lattice windows, peach curtains, lanterns, and floating petals frame the scene. Exclude all watermarks, logos, and readable text.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm daylight through lattice windows at 4200K creates patterned floor shadows with a gentle lantern fill. Sunlight highlights shoulders and chest area while realistic shadows enhance the garment's curves; retain airy sleeve movement, realistic wood patina, and subtle grain.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame 50mm lens at f/2.2, vertical 2:3 crop, full-length frame, softly blurred corridor depth, restrained pastel grade and natural film grain.
